# nobus_lbaas_security_group_rule (Resource)

A security-group rule attached to a Nobus LBaaS load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_security_group_rule" "https" {
  load_balancer_id = nobus_lbaas_load_balancer.example.id
  port             = 443
  source           = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `source` (String) Source CIDR sent as the API `from` field.

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
